entries.en: This structure seems to have significance for the geth. Is it possible they set up this room to serve as a sacred temple of sorts?
What is this place? Almost looks like the geth built themselves some kind of church.
This place seems almost peaceful. Do you think the geth were using this room as some kind of religious temple?
What is this place? Almost looks like the geth built themselves some kind of church.
The layout of this room reminds me of the temples my people used to build. Do you think the geth were using it for religious services?
Hey, if they're looking for God, I'd be happy to speed them on their way.
The geth blur the line between organic and synthetic life. It's natural to assume they seek understanding from a higher power.
Whatever. I ain't here to learn their customs.
Why would a synthetic devote resources to something like this?
You think the geth come here to pray? Do synthetics even believe in God?
